curated-gf-lalezar-gf-inria-serif: Lalezar packs its words into a skyline of stems, its curves barely parted. Inria Serif, a classic serif with wide-mouthed rounds and lighter diagonals, is the more open of the two and works better for brief copy.
curated-gf-langar-gf-actor: Commanding letters with no thinning anywhere in the stroke. Actor, a plain sans with wide s curves barely curled in, keeps a handful of lines easy to take in (basketball jersey lettering would be one place to try it).
curated-gf-langar-gf-iosevka-charon: Langar hits hard with strokes that never thin out. Iosevka Charon, a monospace with rounded forms open to the side, does its best work as a steady stripe of fixed-width ink rather than in long paragraphs.
curated-gf-lavishly-yours-gf-science-got: Lavishly Yours writes its lowercase as modest as chalk dots. Science Gothic sits beside it with far-apart stroke ends and no thick or thin parts, a friendly, upright partner that could carry a war letters keepsake.
curated-gf-league-script-gf-alkalami: Heavy stems, hairline flags, a casual hand. Alkalami, a text serif with a middling spread between its heaviest and lightest parts, is the traditional voice, while League Script supplies the pen-written looseness up top.
curated-gf-lemon-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary, its lowercase oversized. Lemon above it is sturdy and bold with an almost circular c, better for brief copy than long paragraphs (a camping gear brand could borrow that).
curated-gf-lemonada-gf-fira-mono: Lemonada spaces its tight, unmodulated lines like wide-set teeth on a comb, with barely any ascender rising. Fira Mono, a monospace with a ring-shaped c, handles the precise detail where Lemonada makes the statement.
curated-gf-lemonada-gf-piazzolla: Lemonada draws every curve like a compass pencil, with no stress at all. Piazzolla, a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, is better given a little more size than you'd expect.
curated-gf-libertinus-keyboard-fs-nunito: Distinctive, with towering lowercase and curls that pinch shut. Nunito's round bowls and terminals finishing clear of the stem make a friendly opening, and that closed-versus-open difference is the pair's real hook.
curated-gf-libertinus-keyboard-gf-jaldi: Libertinus Keyboard towers over the page, its lowercase lined up like pylons. Jaldi runs with a gaping c and an x-height well above usual, but its tightly brushed letters tire the eye in long paragraphs (a cycling team kit might be a fit).
